title: Topic posture.alerts.v1: decision storage -> gateway (ws), alerts that should be shown
description: Published by the decision storage service (backend/processing report) after it records a collapse_confirmed or reminder decision, only when the session has alerts on (monitor_session.alert_enabled) and the decision is fresh (produced at most 10 s before it was stored). Re-delivered decisions are not published again. The gateway turns each message into a WebSocket alert as is; it does not filter.

event_id.description: event_id of the decision (episodes.v1) that raised this alert

timestamp_ms.description: alert time, ms from session start

onset_ms.description: collapse start, ms from session start
